lines.3: **Status:** design charter only (2026-10-18), no code or backend switch. **Owner:** FiberOpticsSDK. **Authority:** existing Rust-runtime normative requirements/ADRs outrank this additive charter; cross-program decisions: https://github.com/jehalladay/FiberOpticsResearch/tree/main/docs/research/foa/programs/universal-reactive-rendering-2026-10-18.
lines.17: Use one authority per runtime domain; remote public-port bridge may connect independent browser and server runtimes. Bridge requires endpoint visibility/schema/direction, lane and invalidation disposition, source revision, message identity, feedback bound, and explicit resync on gaps. Do not assert global transaction ordering, shared memory or implicit optimistic conflict merge.
lines.23: - PublicPortBridge: negotiate contracts; subscribe/unsubscribe; snapshot/delta/ack/gap/resync; rejects private endpoints. No remotely supplied arbitrary executable functions.
lines.41: - Invalid private-port bridge, bad version/digest, stale epoch, duplicate message, missing basis, unauthorized effect and unbounded feedback are rejected with stable diagnostics.
